typedef long long ll;

struct Fraction {
    ll a, b;
};

pair<ll, ll> geta(int x, int y, int b) {
    ll lower = (ll)b * x / y;
    ll upper = ((ll)b * x + (y-1)) / y;
    return {lower, upper};
}

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    if (b == 0) return a;
    return gcd(b, a % b);
}

void solve(int x, int y, int n) {
    vector<Fraction> cands;
    for (int b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
        auto ap = geta(x, y, b);
        cands.push_back({ap.first, b});
        cands.push_back({ap.second, b});
    }

    auto comp = [&](Fraction fa, Fraction fb)-> bool {
        ll a1 = fa.a;
        ll b1 = fa.b;
        ll a2 = fb.a;
        ll b2 = fb.b;

        ll left = abs(x * b1 * b2 - a1 * b2 * y);
        ll right = abs(x * b1 * b2 - a2 * b1 * y);

        if (left != right) return left < right;

        if (b1 != b2) return b1 < b2;

        return a1 < a2;
    };

    sort(cands.begin(), cands.end(), comp);

    cout << cands.front().a << "/" << cands.front().b << endl;
}

int main(){
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    int x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    solve(x, y, n);

using i64 = long long;

struct Fraction {
    i64 numerator;
    i64 denominator;
};

inline pair<i64, i64> computeApproximations(int x, int y, int b) {
    i64 num = static_cast<i64>(b) * x;
    i64 lower = num / y;
    i64 upper = (num + y - 1) / y;
    return {lower, upper};
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    
    vector<Fraction> pool;
    pool.reserve(2 * n);
    
    for (int b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
        auto [lo, hi] = computeApproximations(x, y, b);
        pool.push_back({lo, b});
        pool.push_back({hi, b});
    }
    
    auto distance = [&](i64 num, i64 den) -> i64 {
        return llabs(static_cast<i64>(x) * den - num * y);
    };
    
    auto cmp = [&](const Fraction& a, const Fraction& b) {
        i64 da = distance(a.numerator, a.denominator);
        i64 db = distance(b.numerator, b.denominator);
        if (da != db) return da < db;
        if (a.denominator != b.denominator) return a.denominator < b.denominator;
        return a.numerator < b.numerator;
    };
    
    nth_element(pool.begin(), pool.begin(), pool.end(), cmp);
    auto best = *min_element(pool.begin(), pool.end(), cmp);
    
    cout << best.numerator << "/" << best.denominator << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
